- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).
TRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.
SKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a pull request
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

This VM is a FRESH setup (May 2026): no prior Claude chats, empty memory, repo at single `initial commit`, nothing installed (no uv/venv/torch/vllm/models/datasets).

Resources: 1× NVIDIA L40S **46 GB VRAM** (CUDA 13.0, driver 580.126.09), 8 vCPU, 31 GB RAM, 1.3 TB disk at /. Docker 29.4.2 available.

SWE-Master shipped configs target far bigger clusters: SFT script = 32B + ring_attn_size 16 (~16×80GB); RL script = 32B, nnodes=8×n_gpus=8 = 64× H800. 32B SFT/RL are infeasible here. Only the 4B variants are viable, and only with reduced seq length + ZeRO-3 + CPU offload + tiny batch. RL (co-located vLLM+FSDP+Docker SWE envs) is extremely tight on one 46GB GPU.

**Why:** every shipped script must be downscaled before running. **How to apply:** never run `qwen_25_coder_32B_*.sh` or `swe_rl_debug_*.sh` as-is — they OOM instantly. See [[training-plan]].

=== SETUP_NOTES.md ===
# SWE-Master RL — RunPod single-H200 setup notes

This document records the state of this checkout so the work can be resumed on
another machine. It complements the chat transcript in
`.claude/projects/-root-swemaster-runpod/*.jsonl`.

## Hardware in use

| Resource | Value |
|----------|-------|
| GPU | 1 × NVIDIA H200 (143 GB VRAM, CUDA 12.8) |
| CPUs | 160 |
| RAM | ~2 TB |
| Persistent volume | `/workspace` (50 GB quota, MooseFS-backed) |
| Root disk | `/` 30 GB overlay |

Important: the original SWE-Master RL pipeline targets **2 × 8 H800 GPUs (16
GPUs)**. The smoke test in
`DeepSWE_RL/rllm/examples/swe/smoke_test_4b_single_h200.sh` is heavily
down-scaled (tensor-parallel = 1, ulysses_sp = 1, batch = 1) so that the
training entrypoint can be exercised on a single GPU; it is not expected to
produce meaningful gradients.

## Layout

```
/workspace/swemaster_runpod/         <- repo (this dir, git remote = origin)
/workspace/venv/                     <- Python 3.11 venv (managed by uv)
/workspace/models/SWE-Master-4B-SFT/ <- HF snapshot of RUC-AIBOX/SWE-Master-4B-SFT
/workspace/uv-cache, /workspace/pip-cache  <- pip/uv wheel caches
/workspace/install.log, /workspace/install2.log  <- pip install transcripts
/workspace/smoke_test.log            <- last smoke-test stdout/stderr
```

## Python environment

Python 3.11.13 in `/workspace/venv`. Re-bootstrap from a fresh machine with:

```bash
uv venv --python 3.11 /workspace/venv
source /workspace/venv/bin/activate
export UV_CACHE_DIR=/workspace/uv-cache PIP_CACHE_DIR=/workspace/pip-cache

# 1) pin torch CUDA 12.8 first
uv pip install --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128 \
    torch==2.7.1 torchvision torchaudio

# 2) install verl + R2E-Gym + rllm in editable mode
cd /workspace/swemaster_runpod/DeepSWE_RL/rllm
git clone --depth 1 --branch v0.5.0 https://github.com/volcengine/verl.git verl   # if missing
uv pip install -e ./verl
uv pip install -e /workspace/swemaster_runpod/R2E-Gym
uv pip install -e /workspace/swemaster_runpod/swebench_fork_swegym-2.0.13-py3-none-any.whl \
               -e /workspace/swemaster_runpod/swebench_fork_swerebench-4.0.3-py3-none-any.whl \
               -e /workspace/swemaster_runpod/swesmith-0.0.7-py3-none-any.whl
uv pip install -e /workspace/swemaster_runpod/DeepSWE_RL/rllm --no-deps

# 3) vllm + flash-attn (large, ~20min build)
uv pip install vllm==0.10.2
uv pip install --no-build-isolation flash-attn==2.8.3
```

Verified-working versions (May 2026):

| Package | Version | Note |
|---------|---------|------|

export VLLM_USE_V1=1

export HYDRA_FULL_ERROR=1
export WANDB_MODE=disabled

# Smoke test of SWE-Master RL pipeline on a single H200 (1 GPU).
# Adapted from swe_rl_debug_hls_try_arsenal_long_step_and_timeout3600_4b.sh
#
# Differences vs. the original 2x8-GPU script:
#   * 1 node, 1 GPU (was 2 nodes x 8 GPUs)
#   * No ulysses sequence-parallel, no tensor parallel
#   * Tiny batch sizes (train=1, mini=1, micro=1)
#   * Local demo parquet from data_examples/ used for train+val
#   * SWE-Master-4B-SFT model from local /workspace/models cache
#   * WANDB disabled (offline); only console + tensorboard
#   * Very short response length to fit in single-GPU memory
#   * One training epoch; save_freq pushed high so we don't write a checkpoint
set -x

# ----------------------- environment ------------------------------------
export VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND=FLASH_ATTN
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF="expandable_segments:False"
export VLLM_USE_V1=1
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export VLLM_ENGINE_ITERATION_TIMEOUT_S=100000000000
export HYDRA_FULL_ERROR=1
export WANDB_MODE=disabled
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=true
export NCCL_DEBUG=WARN
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
# Use parent venv directly: /workspace/venv already has every package the
# upstream runtime_env pip list pins. Cloning the venv into /tmp/ray and then
# pip-installing local wheels by relative path takes ~5min, then fails
# because Ray resolves './swebench_fork_*.whl' from a different cwd.
# See the docstring on run_ppo_agent in rllm.trainer.verl.train_agent_ppo.
export RLLM_USE_PARENT_VENV=1

# rllm package is not installed; expose it via PYTHONPATH
export PYTHONPATH=./DeepSWE_RL/rllm:./R2E-Gym/src:${PYTHONPATH:-}

# ----------------------- paths ------------------------------------------
MODEL_PATH=${MODEL_PATH:-/workspace/models/SWE-Master-4B-SFT}
TRAIN_PARQUET=${TRAIN_PARQUET:-/workspace/swemaster_runpod/data_examples/rl_data/ood_data/equal_0.3999999_0.9999999_swe-gym_and_rebench_demo_for_RL/train_00000_verl.parquet}
VAL_PARQUET=${VAL_PARQUET:-${TRAIN_PARQUET}}

PROJECT_NAME="swe_master_smoke_test"
TS=$(date +"%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S")
EXPERIMENT_NAME="smoke_${TS}"

DEFAULT_LOCAL_DIR="/workspace/training_outputs/${PROJECT_NAME}/${EXPERIMENT_NAME}"
ROLLOUT_DATA_DIR="/workspace/training_outputs_rollout/${PROJECT_NAME}/${EXPERIMENT_NAME}"
mkdir -p "${DEFAULT_LOCAL_DIR}" "${ROLLOUT_DATA_DIR}"

echo "Project: ${PROJECT_NAME}"
echo "Experiment: ${EXPERIMENT_NAME}"
echo "Model: ${MODEL_PATH}"
echo "Train data: ${TRAIN_PARQUET}"
echo "Val data: ${VAL_PARQUET}"

# ----------------------- launch -----------------------------------------
cd /workspace/swemaster_runpod
exec /workspace/venv/bin/python3 -m rllm.trainer.verl.train_agent_ppo \
    algorithm.adv_estimator=loop \
    data.train_files="${TRAIN_PARQUET}" \
    data.val_files="${VAL_PARQUET}" \
    data.train_batch_size=1 \
    data.val_batch_size=1 \
    data.max_prompt_length=4096 \
    data.max_response_length=4096 \
    data.filter_overlong_prompts=True \
    data.filter_overlong_prompts_workers=4 \
    actor_rollout_ref.model.path="${MODEL_PATH}" \
    actor_rollout_ref.hybrid_engine=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.lr=1e-6 \
    actor_rollout_ref.model.use_remove_padding=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.loss_agg_mode=seq-mean-token-sum \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_mini_batch_size=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_dynamic_bsz=False \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_max_token_len_per_gpu=8200 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_kl_loss=False \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.clip_ratio_high=0.28 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_coef=0.0 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_type=low_var_kl \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ulysses_sequence_parallel_size=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.model.enable_gradient_checkpointing=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.param_offload=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.optimizer_offload=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.tensor_model_parallel_size=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.name=vllm \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.mode="async" \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.chat_scheduler=verl.schedulers.completions_scheduler.CompletionsScheduler \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.enforce_eager=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.temperature=1.0 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization=0.55 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.n=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.val_kwargs.n=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.val_kwargs.temperature=0 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_use_dynamic_bsz=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.ref.fsdp_config.param_offload=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.entropy_coeff=0.0 \
    algorithm.kl_ctrl.kl_coef=0.0 \
    algorithm.mask_truncated_samples=False \
    algorithm.clip_advantages=False \
    trainer.critic_warmup=0 \
    trainer.logger=['console','tensorboard'] \
    trainer.project_name="${PROJECT_NAME}" \

    agent.name=sweagent \

## Basic Installation

rLLM uses [verl](https://github.com/volcengine/verl) as its training backend. Follow these steps to install rLLM and our custom fork of verl:

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/agentica-project/rllm.git
cd rllm

# create a conda environment
conda create -n rllm python=3.10
conda activate rllm

# Install all dependencies
pip install -e ./verl
pip install -e .
```

This will install rLLM and all its dependencies in development mode.

For more help, refer to the [GitHub issues page](https://github.com/agentica-project/rllm/issues).

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Rebuild the SWE-Master RL environment on this L40S VM (/home/temp).
# Mirrors the verified recipe in SETUP_NOTES.md, with /workspace -> /home/temp
# and the import-side pins/forks that the H200 work established.
set -Eeuo pipefail

REPO=/home/temp/swemaster_runpod
VENV=/home/temp/venv
export UV_CACHE_DIR=/home/temp/uv-cache
export PIP_CACHE_DIR=/home/temp/pip-cache
export HF_HOME=/home/temp/hf-cache
mkdir -p "$UV_CACHE_DIR" "$PIP_CACHE_DIR" "$HF_HOME"

log() { echo -e "\n========== $* ==========" ; }

log "1. install uv"
if ! command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
fi
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
uv --version

log "2. create py3.11 venv at $VENV"
uv venv --python 3.11 "$VENV"
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source "$VENV/bin/activate"
python --version

log "3. torch cu128 (pinned first so vllm builds against it)"
uv pip install --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128 \
    torch==2.7.1 torchvision torchaudio

log "4. clone agentica-project/verl fork (public volcengine fork lacks _timer)"
cd "$REPO/DeepSWE_RL/rllm"
if [ ! -d verl/.git ]; then
  rm -rf verl
  git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/agentica-project/verl.git verl
fi
git -C verl log --oneline -1

log "5. install verl (editable)"
uv pip install -e ./verl

log "6. install R2E-Gym (editable)"
uv pip install -e "$REPO/R2E-Gym"

log "7. install swebench forks + swesmith wheels"
uv pip install \
    "$REPO/swebench_fork_swegym-2.0.13-py3-none-any.whl" \
    "$REPO/swebench_fork_swerebench-4.0.3-py3-none-any.whl" \
    "$REPO/swesmith-0.0.7-py3-none-any.whl"

log "8. install rllm (editable, no deps)"
uv pip install -e "$REPO/DeepSWE_RL/rllm" --no-deps

log "9. vllm 0.10.2 (bumps torch -> 2.8 cu128)"
uv pip install vllm==0.10.2

log "10. flash-attn 2.8.3 (no build isolation)"
uv pip install --no-build-isolation flash-attn==2.8.3

log "11. import-side pins established on H200"
uv pip install 'setuptools<81' 'transformers>=4.45,<5' 'huggingface_hub<1' tensorboard

log "12. smoke import verify"
python - <<'PY'
import rllm, verl, r2egym, torch, vllm, flash_attn

print("ALL IMPORTS OK")
PY

180 181 # ✨ News 182 + [24 Feb 2026] We have open-sourced the training and inference code, as well as all associated models for [**SWE-Master**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.05592). Start training and evaluating your own code agents! 183 + [4 Feb 2026] ⚡️⚡️ [**SWE-Master**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.05592): We introduce SWE-Master, a fully reproducible post-training framework for Qwen2.5-Coder-32B that integrates agentic SFT and RL to achieve 61.4% (Pass@1) and 70.8% (TTS@8) resolve rates on SWE-bench Verified. Meanwhile, the framework incorporates IDE-level capabilities during inference via LSP-driven tool. 184 + [4 Feb 2026] ⚡️⚡️ [**SWE-World**](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.03419): We introduce SWE-World, a fully Docker-free framework that replaces physical execution environments with learned surrogates. It lifts Qwen2.5-Coder-32B from 6.2% to 55.0% on SWE-bench Verified via agentic SFT and RL, and further attains 68.2% through test-time scaling (TTS@8). 185 186 # 💡 Overview 187 188 **SWE-Master** is an end-to-end, open-source post-training pipeline for software engineering (SWE) agents. It covers **trajectory synthesis & curation**, **long-horizon supervised fine-tuning (SFT)**, **reinforcement learning with execution feedback (RLVR)**, and **test-time scaling (TTS)** via simulated verification and ranking. Furthermore, the framework supports advanced tool-use capabilities, including **LSP-integrated tools** (based on the Language Server Protocol), and incorporates a summary-based context manager for #!/usr/bin/env bash
# Smoke test of SWE-Master RL pipeline on a single H200 (1 GPU).
# Adapted from swe_rl_debug_hls_try_arsenal_long_step_and_timeout3600_4b.sh
#
# Differences vs. the original 2x8-GPU script:
#   * 1 node, 1 GPU (was 2 nodes x 8 GPUs)
#   * No ulysses sequence-parallel, no tensor parallel
#   * Tiny batch sizes (train=1, mini=1, micro=1)
#   * Local demo parquet from data_examples/ used for train+val
#   * SWE-Master-4B-SFT model from local /workspace/models cache
#   * WANDB disabled (offline); only console + tensorboard
#   * Very short response length to fit in single-GPU memory
#   * One training epoch; save_freq pushed high so we don't write a checkpoint
set -x

# ----------------------- environment ------------------------------------
export VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND=FLASH_ATTN
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF="expandable_segments:False"
export VLLM_USE_V1=1
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export VLLM_ENGINE_ITERATION_TIMEOUT_S=100000000000
export HYDRA_FULL_ERROR=1
export WANDB_MODE=disabled
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=true
export NCCL_DEBUG=WARN
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1

# upstream runtime_env pip list pins. Cloning the venv into /tmp/ray and then
# pip-installing local wheels by relative path takes ~5min, then fails
# because Ray resolves './swebench_fork_*.whl' from a different cwd.
# See the docstring on run_ppo_agent in rllm.trainer.verl.train_agent_ppo.
export RLLM_USE_PARENT_VENV=1

# rllm package is not installed; expose it via PYTHONPATH
export PYTHONPATH=./DeepSWE_RL/rllm:./R2E-Gym/src:${PYTHONPATH:-}

# ----------------------- paths ------------------------------------------
MODEL_PATH=${MODEL_PATH:-/workspace/models/SWE-Master-4B-SFT}

VAL_PARQUET=${VAL_PARQUET:-${TRAIN_PARQUET}}

PROJECT_NAME="swe_master_smoke_test"
TS=$(date +"%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S")
EXPERIMENT_NAME="smoke_${TS}"

DEFAULT_LOCAL_DIR="/workspace/training_outputs/${PROJECT_NAME}/${EXPERIMENT_NAME}"
ROLLOUT_DATA_DIR="/workspace/training_outputs_rollout/${PROJECT_NAME}/${EXPERIMENT_NAME}"
mkdir -p "${DEFAULT_LOCAL_DIR}" "${ROLLOUT_DATA_DIR}"

echo "Project: ${PROJECT_NAME}"
echo "Experiment: ${EXPERIMENT_NAME}"
echo "Model: ${MODEL_PATH}"
echo "Train data: ${TRAIN_PARQUET}"
echo "Val data: ${VAL_PARQUET}"

    data.filter_overlong_prompts_workers=4 \
    actor_rollout_ref.model.path="${MODEL_PATH}" \
    actor_rollout_ref.hybrid_engine=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.lr=1e-6 \
    actor_rollout_ref.model.use_remove_padding=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.loss_agg_mode=seq-mean-token-sum \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_mini_batch_size=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_dynamic_bsz=False \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_max_token_len_per_gpu=8200 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_kl_loss=False \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.clip_ratio_high=0.28 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_coef=0.0 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_type=low_var_kl \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ulysses_sequence_parallel_size=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.model.enable_gradient_checkpointing=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.param_offload=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.optimizer_offload=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.tensor_model_parallel_size=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.name=vllm \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.mode="async" \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.chat_scheduler=verl.schedulers.completions_scheduler.CompletionsScheduler \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.enforce_eager=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.temperature=1.0 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization=0.55 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.n=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.val_kwargs.n=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.val_kwargs.temperature=0 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_use_dynamic_bsz=True \

    actor_rollout_ref.ref.fsdp_config.param_offload=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.entropy_coeff=0.0 \
    algorithm.kl_ctrl.kl_coef=0.0 \
    algorithm.mask_truncated_samples=False \
    algorithm.clip_advantages=False \
    trainer.critic_warmup=0 \
    trainer.logger=['console','tensorboard'] \
    trainer.project_name="${PROJECT_NAME}" \
    trainer.experiment_name="${EXPERIMENT_NAME}" \
    trainer.default_local_dir="${DEFAULT_LOCAL_DIR}" \
    trainer.rollout_data_dir="${ROLLOUT_DATA_DIR}" \
    trainer.val_before_train=False \
    trainer.n_gpus_per_node=1 \
    trainer.nnodes=1 \
    trainer.save_freq=1000 \
    trainer.test_freq=-1 \
    trainer.default_hdfs_dir=null \
    env.name=swe_arsenal \
    +env.env_args.delete_image=False \

    +env.env_args.backend="docker" \
    agent.name=sweagent \

    agent.async_engine=True \
    +agent.agent_args.scaffold="openhands" \
    trainer.total_epochs=1

def run_ppo_agent(config):
    if not ray.is_initialized():
        # RLLM_USE_PARENT_VENV=1 skips the pip-install runtime_env so Ray workers
        # use the parent process's venv directly. The upstream pip list pins local
        # wheels by relative path (`./swebench_fork_*-py3-none-any.whl`), which
        # Ray resolves from its own runtime_resources/exec_cwd — those files do
        # not exist there, so pip fails. When the parent venv already has every
        # package (the case for /workspace/venv after the documented install),
        # the runtime_env clone is also pure wasted time and disk.
        if os.environ.get("RLLM_USE_PARENT_VENV") == "1":
            # Use absolute paths so workers spawned with a different cwd still
            # resolve the rllm/verl/r2egym source trees.
            project_root = os.environ.get(
                "RLLM_PROJECT_ROOT", "/workspace/swemaster_runpod"
            )
            ray.init(runtime_env={
                "env_vars": {
                    "TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM": os.environ.get("TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM", "true"),
                    "NCCL_DEBUG": os.environ.get("NCCL_DEBUG", "WARN"),
                    "PYTHONPATH": (
                        f"{project_root}/DeepSWE_RL/rllm:"
                        f"{project_root}/DeepSWE_RL/rllm/verl:"
                        f"{project_root}/R2E-Gym/src:"
                        + os.environ.get("PYTHONPATH", "")
                    ),
                    "WANDB_MODE": os.environ.get("WANDB_MODE", "disabled"),
                    "RLLM_PROJECT_ROOT": project_root,
                },
            })
        else:
            ray.init(runtime_env={"pip": ["sentence_transformers",'polars',"swebench==3.0.2","dm-tree","gym>=0.26.2","kubernetes>=32.0.1","fire",
            "./swebench_fork_swegym-2.0.13-py3-none-any.whl",

export RLLM_USE_PARENT_VENV=1
# train_agent_ppo's runtime_env rebuilds PYTHONPATH from this; default is the
# old /workspace path, so it MUST be set to this VM's repo.

# rllm package is not installed; expose it via PYTHONPATH

# ---- host-RAM containment (this VM has only 31 GB; H200 pod had ~2 TB) ----
# FSDP param/optimizer offload pushes the 4B model to CPU RAM. Ray's default
# auto-sized object store (~30% RAM ≈ 9 GB) plus its 0.95 OOM-killer leaves no
# headroom and kills the worker mid-init. Pre-start a Ray cluster with a tiny
# object store and the memory monitor disabled, then attach to it. The docker
# rollout boundary is reached in fit_agent BEFORE the optimizer step, so we
# only need to survive the init peak, not hold fp32 optimizer states.
export RAY_memory_monitor_refresh_ms=0
export RAY_DISABLE_DOCKER_CPU_WARNING=1
export RAY_ADDRESS="local"
ray stop --force >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
ray start --head --num-cpus=8 \
    --object-store-memory=1500000000 \
    --memory=24000000000 \
    --disable-usage-stats >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
export RAY_ADDRESS="auto"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Smoke test of SWE-Master RL pipeline on a single L40S (1 GPU, 46 GB).
# Adapted from smoke_test_4b_single_h200.sh; the H200 had 143 GB so the
# vLLM gpu_memory_utilization and sequence lengths are cut here to fit 46 GB.
#
# Differences vs. the original 2x8-GPU script:
#   * 1 node, 1 GPU (was 2 nodes x 8 GPUs)
#   * No ulysses sequence-parallel, no tensor parallel
#   * Tiny batch sizes (train=1, mini=1, micro=1)
#   * Local demo parquet from data_examples/ used for train+val
#   * SWE-Master-4B-SFT model from local /home/temp/models cache
#   * gpu_memory_utilization 0.55 -> 0.38, response 4096 -> 3072 (46 GB budget)
#   * WANDB disabled (offline); only console + tensorboard
#   * Very short response length to fit in single-GPU memory
#   * One training epoch; save_freq pushed high so we don't write a checkpoint
set -x

# ----------------------- environment ------------------------------------
export VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND=FLASH_ATTN
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF="expandable_segments:False"
export VLLM_USE_V1=1
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export VLLM_ENGINE_ITERATION_TIMEOUT_S=100000000000
export HYDRA_FULL_ERROR=1
export WANDB_MODE=disabled
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=true
export NCCL_DEBUG=WARN
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
# Use parent venv directly: /workspace/venv already has every package the
# upstream runtime_env pip list pins. Cloning the venv into /tmp/ray and then
# pip-installing local wheels by relative path takes ~5min, then fails
# because Ray resolves './swebench_fork_*.whl' from a different cwd.
# See the docstring on run_ppo_agent in rllm.trainer.verl.train_agent_ppo.
export RLLM_USE_PARENT_VENV=1

# rllm package is not installed; expose it via PYTHONPATH
export PYTHONPATH=./DeepSWE_RL/rllm:./R2E-Gym/src:${PYTHONPATH:-}

# ----------------------- paths ------------------------------------------
REPO_DIR=${REPO_DIR:-/home/temp/swemaster_runpod}
MODEL_PATH=${MODEL_PATH:-/home/temp/models/SWE-Master-4B-SFT}
TRAIN_PARQUET=${TRAIN_PARQUET:-${REPO_DIR}/data_examples/rl_data/ood_data/equal_0.3999999_0.9999999_swe-gym_and_rebench_demo_for_RL/train_00000_verl.parquet}
VAL_PARQUET=${VAL_PARQUET:-${TRAIN_PARQUET}}
PYTHON_BIN=${PYTHON_BIN:-/home/temp/venv/bin/python3}

PROJECT_NAME="swe_master_smoke_test"
TS=$(date +"%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S")
EXPERIMENT_NAME="smoke_${TS}"

DEFAULT_LOCAL_DIR="/home/temp/training_outputs/${PROJECT_NAME}/${EXPERIMENT_NAME}"
ROLLOUT_DATA_DIR="/home/temp/training_outputs_rollout/${PROJECT_NAME}/${EXPERIMENT_NAME}"
mkdir -p "${DEFAULT_LOCAL_DIR}" "${ROLLOUT_DATA_DIR}"

echo "Project: ${PROJECT_NAME}"
echo "Experiment: ${EXPERIMENT_NAME}"
echo "Model: ${MODEL_PATH}"
echo "Train data: ${TRAIN_PARQUET}"
echo "Val data: ${VAL_PARQUET}"

# ----------------------- launch -----------------------------------------
cd "${REPO_DIR}"
exec "${PYTHON_BIN}" -m rllm.trainer.verl.train_agent_ppo \
    algorithm.adv_estimator=loop \

    actor_rollout_ref.model.use_remove_padding=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.loss_agg_mode=seq-mean-token-sum \

    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_kl_loss=False \

    actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_coef=0.0 \

    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ulysses_sequence_parallel_size=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.model.enable_gradient_checkpointing=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.param_offload=True \

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Smoke test of SWE-Master RL pipeline on a single L40S (1 GPU, 46 GB).
# Adapted from smoke_test_4b_single_h200.sh; the H200 had 143 GB so the
# vLLM gpu_memory_utilization and sequence lengths are cut here to fit 46 GB.
#
# Differences vs. the original 2x8-GPU script:
#   * 1 node, 1 GPU (was 2 nodes x 8 GPUs)
#   * No ulysses sequence-parallel, no tensor parallel
#   * Tiny batch sizes (train=1, mini=1, micro=1)
#   * Local demo parquet from data_examples/ used for train+val
#   * SWE-Master-4B-SFT model from local /home/temp/models cache
#   * gpu_memory_utilization 0.55 -> 0.38, response 4096 -> 3072 (46 GB budget)
#   * WANDB disabled (offline); only console + tensorboard
#   * Very short response length to fit in single-GPU memory
#   * One training epoch; save_freq pushed high so we don't write a checkpoint
set -x

# ----------------------- environment ------------------------------------
export VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND=FLASH_ATTN
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF="expandable_segments:False"
export VLLM_USE_V1=1
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export VLLM_ENGINE_ITERATION_TIMEOUT_S=100000000000
export HYDRA_FULL_ERROR=1
export WANDB_MODE=disabled
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=true
export NCCL_DEBUG=WARN
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
# Use parent venv directly: /workspace/venv already has every package the
# upstream runtime_env pip list pins. Cloning the venv into /tmp/ray and then
# pip-installing local wheels by relative path takes ~5min, then fails
# because Ray resolves './swebench_fork_*.whl' from a different cwd.
# See the docstring on run_ppo_agent in rllm.trainer.verl.train_agent_ppo.
export RLLM_USE_PARENT_VENV=1
# train_agent_ppo's runtime_env rebuilds PYTHONPATH from this; default is the
# old /workspace path, so it MUST be set to this VM's repo.
export RLLM_PROJECT_ROOT=/home/temp/swemaster_runpod

# rllm package is not installed; expose it via PYTHONPATH
export PYTHONPATH=./DeepSWE_RL/rllm:./R2E-Gym/src:${PYTHONPATH:-}

# ---- host-RAM containment (this VM has only 31 GB; H200 pod had ~2 TB) ----
# FSDP param/optimizer offload pushes the 4B model to CPU RAM. Ray's default
# auto-sized object store (~30% RAM ≈ 9 GB) plus its 0.95 OOM-killer leaves no
# headroom and kills the worker mid-init. Pre-start a Ray cluster with a tiny
# object store and the memory monitor disabled, then attach to it. The docker
# rollout boundary is reached in fit_agent BEFORE the optimizer step, so we
# only need to survive the init peak, not hold fp32 optimizer states.
export RAY_memory_monitor_refresh_ms=0
export RAY_DISABLE_DOCKER_CPU_WARNING=1
export RAY_ADDRESS="local"
ray stop --force >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
ray start --head --num-cpus=8 \
    --object-store-memory=1500000000 \
    --memory=24000000000 \
    --disable-usage-stats >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
export RAY_ADDRESS="auto"

# ----------------------- paths ------------------------------------------
REPO_DIR=${REPO_DIR:-/home/temp/swemaster_runpod}
MODEL_PATH=${MODEL_PATH:-/home/temp/models/SWE-Master-4B-SFT}
TRAIN_PARQUET=${TRAIN_PARQUET:-${REPO_DIR}/data_examples/rl_data/ood_data/equal_0.3999999_0.9999999_swe-gym_and_rebench_demo_for_RL/train_00000_verl.parquet}
VAL_PARQUET=${VAL_PARQUET:-${TRAIN_PARQUET}}
PYTHON_BIN=${PYTHON_BIN:-/home/temp/venv/bin/python3}

PROJECT_NAME="swe_master_smoke_test"
TS=$(date +"%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S")
EXPERIMENT_NAME="smoke_${TS}"

DEFAULT_LOCAL_DIR="/home/temp/training_outputs/${PROJECT_NAME}/${EXPERIMENT_NAME}"
ROLLOUT_DATA_DIR="/home/temp/training_outputs_rollout/${PROJECT_NAME}/${EXPERIMENT_NAME}"
mkdir -p "${DEFAULT_LOCAL_DIR}" "${ROLLOUT_DATA_DIR}"

echo "Project: ${PROJECT_NAME}"
echo "Experiment: ${EXPERIMENT_NAME}"
echo "Model: ${MODEL_PATH}"
echo "Train data: ${TRAIN_PARQUET}"
echo "Val data: ${VAL_PARQUET}"

# ----------------------- launch -----------------------------------------
cd "${REPO_DIR}"
exec "${PYTHON_BIN}" -m rllm.trainer.verl.train_agent_ppo \
    algorithm.adv_estimator=loop \
    data.train_files="${TRAIN_PARQUET}" \
    data.val_files="${VAL_PARQUET}" \
    data.train_batch_size=1 \
    data.val_batch_size=1 \
    data.max_prompt_length=4096 \
    data.max_response_length=3072 \
    data.filter_overlong_prompts=True \
    data.filter_overlong_prompts_workers=4 \
    actor_rollout_ref.model.path="${MODEL_PATH}" \
    actor_rollout_ref.hybrid_engine=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.lr=1e-6 \
    actor_rollout_ref.model.use_remove_padding=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.loss_agg_mode=seq-mean-token-sum \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_mini_batch_size=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_dynamic_bsz=False \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_max_token_len_per_gpu=7200 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_kl_loss=False \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.clip_ratio_high=0.28 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_coef=0.0 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_type=low_var_kl \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ulysses_sequence_parallel_size=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.model.enable_gradient_checkpointing=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.param_offload=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.optimizer_offload=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.tensor_model_parallel_size=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.name=vllm \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.mode="async" \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.chat_scheduler=verl.schedulers.completions_scheduler.CompletionsScheduler \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.enforce_eager=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.temperature=1.0 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization=0.38 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.n=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.val_kwargs.n=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.val_kwargs.temperature=0 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_use_dynamic_bsz=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.ref.fsdp_config.param_offload=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.entropy_coeff=0.0 \
    algorithm.kl_ctrl.kl_coef=0.0 \
    algorithm.mask_truncated_samples=False \
    algorithm.clip_advantages=False \
    trainer.critic_warmup=0 \
    trainer.logger=['console','tensorboard'] \
    trainer.project_name="${PROJECT_NAME}" \
    trainer.experiment_name="${EXPERIMENT_NAME}" \
    trainer.default_local_dir="${DEFAULT_LOCAL_DIR}" \
    trainer.rollout_data_dir="${ROLLOUT_DATA_DIR}" \
    trainer.val_before_train=False \
    trainer.n_gpus_per_node=1 \
    trainer.nnodes=1 \
    trainer.save_freq=1000 \
    trainer.test_freq=-1 \
    trainer.default_hdfs_dir=null \
    env.name=swe_arsenal \
    +env.env_args.delete_image=False \
    +env.env_args.scaffold="openhands" \
    +env.env_args.backend="docker" \
    agent.name=sweagent \
    agent.max_steps=4 \
    agent.overlong_filter=True \
    agent.trajectory_timeout=300 \
    agent.async_engine=True \
    +agent.agent_args.scaffold="openhands" \
    trainer.total_epochs=1

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Smoke test of SWE-Master RL pipeline on a single L40S (1 GPU, 46 GB).
# Adapted from smoke_test_4b_single_h200.sh; the H200 had 143 GB so the
# vLLM gpu_memory_utilization and sequence lengths are cut here to fit 46 GB.
#
# Differences vs. the original 2x8-GPU script:
#   * 1 node, 1 GPU (was 2 nodes x 8 GPUs)
#   * No ulysses sequence-parallel, no tensor parallel
#   * Tiny batch sizes (train=1, mini=1, micro=1)
#   * Local demo parquet from data_examples/ used for train+val
#   * SWE-Master-4B-SFT model from local /home/temp/models cache
#   * gpu_memory_utilization 0.55 -> 0.38, response 4096 -> 3072 (46 GB budget)
#   * WANDB disabled (offline); only console + tensorboard
#   * Very short response length to fit in single-GPU memory
#   * One training epoch; save_freq pushed high so we don't write a checkpoint
set -x

# ----------------------- environment ------------------------------------
export VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND=FLASH_ATTN
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF="expandable_segments:False"
export VLLM_USE_V1=1
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export VLLM_ENGINE_ITERATION_TIMEOUT_S=100000000000
export HYDRA_FULL_ERROR=1
export WANDB_MODE=disabled
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=true
export NCCL_DEBUG=WARN
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
# Use parent venv directly: /workspace/venv already has every package the
# upstream runtime_env pip list pins. Cloning the venv into /tmp/ray and then
# pip-installing local wheels by relative path takes ~5min, then fails
# because Ray resolves './swebench_fork_*.whl' from a different cwd.
# See the docstring on run_ppo_agent in rllm.trainer.verl.train_agent_ppo.
export RLLM_USE_PARENT_VENV=1
# train_agent_ppo's runtime_env rebuilds PYTHONPATH from this; default is the
# old /workspace path, so it MUST be set to this VM's repo.
export RLLM_PROJECT_ROOT=/home/temp/swemaster_runpod

# rllm package is not installed; expose it via PYTHONPATH
export PYTHONPATH=./DeepSWE_RL/rllm:./R2E-Gym/src:${PYTHONPATH:-}

# ---- host-RAM containment (this VM has only 31 GB; H200 pod had ~2 TB) ----
# FSDP param/optimizer offload pushes the 4B model to CPU RAM. Ray's default
# auto-sized object store (~30% RAM ≈ 9 GB) plus its 0.95 OOM-killer leaves no
# headroom and kills the worker mid-init. Pre-start a Ray cluster with a tiny
# object store and the memory monitor disabled, then attach to it. The docker
# rollout boundary is reached in fit_agent BEFORE the optimizer step, so we
# only need to survive the init peak, not hold fp32 optimizer states.
export RAY_memory_monitor_refresh_ms=0
export RAY_DISABLE_DOCKER_CPU_WARNING=1
export RAY_ADDRESS="local"
/home/temp/venv/bin/ray stop --force >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
/home/temp/venv/bin/ray start --head --num-cpus=8 \
    --object-store-memory=1500000000 \
    --memory=24000000000 \
    --disable-usage-stats >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
export RAY_ADDRESS="auto"

# ----------------------- paths ------------------------------------------
REPO_DIR=${REPO_DIR:-/home/temp/swemaster_runpod}
MODEL_PATH=${MODEL_PATH:-/home/temp/models/SWE-Master-4B-SFT}
TRAIN_PARQUET=${TRAIN_PARQUET:-${REPO_DIR}/data_examples/rl_data/ood_data/equal_0.3999999_0.9999999_swe-gym_and_rebench_demo_for_RL/train_00000_verl.parquet}
VAL_PARQUET=${VAL_PARQUET:-${TRAIN_PARQUET}}
PYTHON_BIN=${PYTHON_BIN:-/home/temp/venv/bin/python3}

PROJECT_NAME="swe_master_smoke_test"
TS=$(date +"%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S")
EXPERIMENT_NAME="smoke_${TS}"

DEFAULT_LOCAL_DIR="/home/temp/training_outputs/${PROJECT_NAME}/${EXPERIMENT_NAME}"
ROLLOUT_DATA_DIR="/home/temp/training_outputs_rollout/${PROJECT_NAME}/${EXPERIMENT_NAME}"
mkdir -p "${DEFAULT_LOCAL_DIR}" "${ROLLOUT_DATA_DIR}"

echo "Project: ${PROJECT_NAME}"
echo "Experiment: ${EXPERIMENT_NAME}"
echo "Model: ${MODEL_PATH}"
echo "Train data: ${TRAIN_PARQUET}"
echo "Val data: ${VAL_PARQUET}"

# ----------------------- launch -----------------------------------------
cd "${REPO_DIR}"
exec "${PYTHON_BIN}" -m rllm.trainer.verl.train_agent_ppo \
    algorithm.adv_estimator=loop \
    data.train_files="${TRAIN_PARQUET}" \
    data.val_files="${VAL_PARQUET}" \
    data.train_batch_size=1 \
    data.val_batch_size=1 \
    data.max_prompt_length=4096 \
    data.max_response_length=3072 \
    data.filter_overlong_prompts=True \
    data.filter_overlong_prompts_workers=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.model.path="${MODEL_PATH}" \
    actor_rollout_ref.hybrid_engine=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.lr=1e-6 \
    actor_rollout_ref.model.use_remove_padding=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.loss_agg_mode=seq-mean-token-sum \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_mini_batch_size=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_dynamic_bsz=False \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_max_token_len_per_gpu=7200 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_kl_loss=False \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.clip_ratio_high=0.28 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_coef=0.0 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_type=low_var_kl \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ulysses_sequence_parallel_size=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.model.enable_gradient_checkpointing=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.param_offload=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.optimizer_offload=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.tensor_model_parallel_size=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.name=vllm \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.mode="async" \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.chat_scheduler=verl.schedulers.completions_scheduler.CompletionsScheduler \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.enforce_eager=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.swap_space=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.temperature=1.0 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization=0.38 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.n=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.val_kwargs.n=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.val_kwargs.temperature=0 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_use_dynamic_bsz=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.ref.fsdp_config.param_offload=True \

from typing import Callable

import torch
from torch.utils.data import Dataset

from openrlhf.utils.utils import zero_pad_sequences

# keep support for conversations style
def preprocess_data(
    data, input_template=None, input_key="input", output_key=None, apply_chat_template=None, multiturn=False
):
    if apply_chat_template:
        if output_key:
            kill

        else:
            prompt = apply_chat_template(data[input_key][:-1], tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True)
            response = apply_chat_template(data[input_key], tokenize=False)[len(prompt) :]
    else:
        kill
    return prompt, response


class SFTDataset(Dataset):
    """
    Dataset for SFT model

    Args:
        dataset: dataset for SFT model
        tokenizer: tokenizer for SFT model
        max_length: max length of input
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        dataset,
        tokenizer: Callable,
        max_length: int,
        strategy,
        input_template=None,
        pretrain_mode=False,
        num_processors=16,  # Specify the number of processors you want to use
        multiturn=False,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.strategy = strategy
        self.pretrain_mode = pretrain_mode
        self.max_length = max_length
        self.multiturn = multiturn

        # chat template
        self.input_template = input_template
        self.input_key = getattr(self.strategy.args, "input_key", None)
        self.output_key = getattr(self.strategy.args, "output_key", None)
        self.apply_chat_template = getattr(self.strategy.args, "apply_chat_template", True)

        if self.apply_chat_template:
            self.apply_chat_template = self.tokenizer.apply_chat_template
            tokenizer_chat_template = getattr(self.strategy.args, "tokenizer_chat_template", None)
            if tokenizer_chat_template:
                self.tokenizer.chat_template = tokenizer_chat_template

        # Parallel loading datasets
        if not self.multiturn:
            processed_dataset = dataset.map(
                self.process_data,
                remove_columns=dataset.column_names,
                num_proc=num_processors,
            )
            
            # processed_dataset = dataset
            processed_dataset = processed_dataset.filter(lambda x: x["prompt"] is not None)

            # Store the processed data in class attributes
            self.prompts = processed_dataset["prompt"]
            self.responses = processed_dataset["response"]
            self.prompt_ids_lens = processed_dataset["prompt_ids_len"]
            self.response_ranges = processed_dataset["response_ranges"] if self.multiturn else None
            
        else: # multiturn
            processed_dataset = dataset
            processed_dataset = processed_dataset.filter(lambda x: x["prompt"] is not None)
            self.prompts = processed_dataset["prompt"]
            self.responses = processed_dataset["response"]
            self.prompt_ids_lens = processed_dataset["prompt_ids_len"]
            self.response_ranges = processed_dataset["response_ranges"] if self.multiturn else None



    def process_data(self, data):
        # kill
        #  data: dict or batch
        if not hasattr(self, "_process_count"):
            self._process_count = 0
            self._total = len(data["some_key"]) if "some_key" in data else 0

            data[self.input_key].append(data[self.output_key])
            data[self.output_key] = None

        if self.multiturn:
            assert (
                not self.output_key or not data[self.output_key]
            ), "You should put the whole trajactory into data[input_key] and do not set output_key"
            input_key = self.input_key
            apply_chat_template = self.apply_chat_template
            # print(self.apply_chat_template)
            # response_ranges = []
            # response_prompts = []
            # response_texts = []
            # assistant_indices = []
            # for idx, message in enumerate(data[input_key]):
            #     if message["role"] == "assistant":
            #         prompt = apply_chat_template(
            #             data[input_key][:idx],
            #             tokenize=False,
            #             add_generation_prompt=True,
            #         )
            #         response = apply_chat_template(
            #             data[input_key][:idx + 1],
            #             tokenize=False
            #         )[len(prompt):]

            #         response_prompts.append(prompt)
            #         response_texts.append(response)
            #         assistant_indices.append(idx)
            # prompt_tokens = self.tokenizer(
            #                 response_prompts,
            #                 max_length=self.max_length,
            #                 padding=False,
            #                 truncation=True,
            #                 return_tensors=None, 
            #                 add_special_tokens=False,
            #             )
            # response_tokens = self.tokenizer(
            #                 response_texts,
            #                 max_length=self.max_length,
            #                 padding=False,
            #                 truncation=True,
            #                 return_tensors=None, 
            #                 add_special_tokens=False,
            #             )

            # prompt_lens = [sum(x) for x in prompt_tokens["attention_mask"]]
            # response_lens = [sum(x) for x in response_tokens["attention_mask"]]

            # response_ranges = []
            # for p_len, r_len in zip(prompt_lens, response_lens):
            #     start_idx = p_len
            #     end_idx = p_len + r_len - 1
            #     response_ranges.append((start_idx, end_idx))

            # for idx, message in enumerate(data[input_key]):
            #     if message["role"] == "assistant":
            #         prompt = apply_chat_template(data[input_key][:idx], tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True)
            #         response = apply_chat_template(data[input_key][: idx + 1], tokenize=False)[len(prompt) :]

            #         start_idx = (
            #             self.tokenizer(
            #                 prompt,
            #                 max_length=self.max_length,
            #                 padding=False,
            #                 truncation=True,
            #                 return_tensors="pt",
            #                 add_special_tokens=False,
            #             )["attention_mask"]
            #             .int()
            #             .sum()
            #             .item()
            #         )

            #         end_idx = (
            #             start_idx
            #             + self.tokenizer(
            #                 response,
            #                 max_length=self.max_length,

            #                 truncation=True,

            #             .sum()
            #             .item()
            #             - 1
            #         )
            #         response_ranges.append((start_idx, end_idx))  # left close right close
        
        prompt, response = preprocess_data(
            data,
            None if self.pretrain_mode else self.input_template,
            self.input_key,
            self.output_key,
            apply_chat_template=None if self.pretrain_mode else self.apply_chat_template,
            multiturn=self.multiturn,
        )
        # print(prompt)
        # kill

        if not self.pretrain_mode:
            prompt_token = self.tokenizer(
                prompt,
                max_length=self.max_length,
                padding=False,
                truncation=True,
                return_tensors="pt",
                add_special_tokens=False,
            )
            prompt_ids_len = prompt_token["attention_mask"].int().sum().item()
            # filter the sample whose length is greater than max_length (2 for answer length)
            # print((prompt_ids_len))
            # print(self.max_length)
            if not prompt or not response or prompt_ids_len >= self.max_length - 2:
                prompt = None
        else:
            prompt_ids_len = 0

        return {
            "prompt": prompt,
            "response": response,
            "prompt_ids_len": prompt_ids_len,
            "response_ranges": response_ranges if self.multiturn else None,
        }

    def __len__(self):
        length = len(self.prompts)
        return length

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        prompt = self.prompts[idx]
        response = self.responses[idx]

        if not self.pretrain_mode:
            text = (prompt + response).rstrip("\n")
            if not text.endswith(self.tokenizer.eos_token):
                text += " " + self.tokenizer.eos_token
        else:
            text = prompt

        input_token = self.tokenizer(
            text,
            max_length=self.max_length,
            padding=False,
            truncation=True,
            return_tensors="pt",
            add_special_tokens=False,
        )
        input_ids = input_token["input_ids"]
        attention_mask = input_token["attention_mask"]
        loss_mask = self.get_loss_mask(input_ids, idx)

        if not self.pretrain_mode:
            # to avoid EOS_token truncation
            input_ids[0][-1] = self.tokenizer.eos_token_id
            attention_mask[0][-1] = True
        return input_ids, attention_mask, loss_mask

    def get_loss_mask(self, input_ids, idx):
        if self.pretrain_mode:
            return torch.ones_like(input_ids, dtype=torch.float32)  # shape:[1, seq_len]

        loss_mask = torch.zeros_like(input_ids, dtype=torch.float32)
        if not self.multiturn:
            prompt_ids_len = self.prompt_ids_lens[idx]
            loss_mask[0, prompt_ids_len - 1 : -1] = 1
        else:
            response_ranges = self.response_ranges[idx]
            for start_idx, end_idx in response_ranges:
                loss_mask[0, start_idx - 1 : end_idx] = 1
        return loss_mask

    def collate_fn(self, item_list):
        input_ids = []
        attention_masks = []
        loss_masks = []

        for input_id, attention_mask, loss_mask in item_list:
            input_ids.append(input_id)
            attention_masks.append(attention_mask)
            loss_masks.append(loss_mask)

        input_ids = zero_pad_sequences(input_ids, "right", self.tokenizer.pad_token_id)
        attention_masks = zero_pad_sequences(attention_masks, "right")
        loss_masks = zero_pad_sequences(loss_masks, "right")
        return input_ids, attention_masks, loss_masks

if __name__ == "__main__":
    pass

**Loaded prior context.** The "previous chats" were on a different **RunPod H200 (143 GB)** pod — fully captured in `SETUP_NOTES.md` + git branch `setup/runpod-h200`. |---|---|

| r2egym Docker TLS hardcode | ✅ Patched (the next blocker SETUP_NOTES flagged) |

**Blockers cleared along the way:** missing `polars`/rllm deps (installed), stale `/workspace` paths (repointed), invalid `swap_space` config key (removed), and the big one — **host-RAM OOM**: FSDP CPU-offload of the 4B model exceeds 31 GB RAM (H200 had 2 TB). Fixed by adding a **96 GB swapfile**.

Now I have a clear picture of the data pipeline. Key insights:

- `data_examples/sft_data/openrlhf_sft_multi_turn_data_demo.jsonl` (5 records) is **already in the processed multiturn format** (`prompt`, `response`, `prompt_ids_len`, `response_ranges`) that the custom `sft_dataset.py` consumes directly in `--multiturn` mode. Token offsets were computed with the **Qwen2.5-Coder tokenizer** (shared across all Qwen2.5-Coder sizes), so a smaller Qwen2.5-Coder model can train on it without re-tokenizing.
- These are long agentic trajectories (29K–60K tokens). Full-parameter SFT memory is bound by **CPU RAM (31GB)** for optimizer offload, not just VRAM. That caps the feasible full-FT model at **Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct** on this box (3B/7B optimizer states exceed 31GB RAM even with offload).

Decision: target **full-parameter SFT of Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct** on the demo data, in an **NGC PyTorch Docker container** (gives matched CUDA/torch/flash-attn, aligns with your Docker emphasis, avoids native ABI hell). Let me record the plan and start the (large) image pull in the background.

content.text:
Now the real picture is clear. The pipeline **works end-to-end past the H200 blocker** (vLLM ✅, rollout engine ✅, Docker client ✅), but there are two data issues:

1. **Prompt too long**: demo task prompt is 4561 tokens > my `max_prompt_length=4096` → trajectory exits before even touching Docker.
2. **Private registry**: the demo task's image is `harbor.weizhipin.com/arsenal-ai/...` — BOSS Zhipin's internal Harbor registry, **unpullable** here. No container → no reward → no learning.

Let me verify and find public-image SWE tasks so the agent can actually execute and earn reward:

input.command:
cd /home/temp/swemaster_runpod
echo "=== demo parquet contents (images referenced) ===" 
/home/temp/venv/bin/python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, json, glob
f="data_examples/rl_data/ood_data/equal_0.3999999_0.9999999_swe-gym_and_rebench_demo_for_RL/train_00000_verl.parquet"
df=pd.read_parquet(f)
print("rows:", len(df), "cols:", list(df.columns))
for i,r in df.iterrows():
    ei=r.get('extra_info'); 
    try: ei=json.loads(ei) if isinstance(ei,str) else ei
    except: pass
    rm=r.get('reward_model')
    img=None
    s=json.dumps(r.to_dict(), default=str)
    import re
    m=re.findall(r'(harbor\.weizhipin\.com[^\"\\\\ ]+|docker\.io/[^\"\\\\ ]+|swebench/[^\"\\\\ ]+|[a-z0-9_.-]*sweb\.eval[^\"\\\\ ]+)', s)
    print(f"row {i}: image_refs={set(m)}")
    print(f"   extra_info keys={list(ei.keys()) if isinstance(ei,dict) else type(ei)}")
PY

Definitive: `start_container` calls `containers.run(docker_image)` which **pulls** the image — there's no build-from-spec path. So the original demo data's private `harbor.weizhipin.com` images simply cannot work outside BOSS Zhipin's network.     def from_dict(extra_info: dict | str) -> "SWEEnv":
        """Create an environment instance from JSON configuration.

        Args:
            extra_info: Dictionary containing configuration parameters

        Returns:
            Initialized SWEEnv instance
        """
        import inspect

        if isinstance(extra_info, str):
            extra_info = json.loads(extra_info)

        sig = inspect.signature(SWEEnv.__init__)
        init_params = {}
        for param_name, param in sig.parameters.items():
            
            if param_name == "self":
                continue
            if param_name in extra_info:
                init_params[param_name] = extra_info[param_name]
        
        init_params["entry"] = extra_info
        return SWEEnv(**init_params)

content.text: Classic Python scoping bug in r2egym: `make_test_spec` is imported at module level (line 35), but inside `__init__` the swebench branch does `make_test_spec = json.loads(...)`, making it a **local** for the whole method — so line 239's `make_test_spec(self.ds)` raises `UnboundLocalError`. The authors never hit it because their internal data always embedded the spec. The clean fix: rename the local assignments so they don't shadow the imported function.

        logger.info(f"in trajectory_generator max_concurrency:{max_concurrency}")

            max_concurrent: Maximum number of concurrent tasks to process (defaults to self.n_parallel_agents)

        Returns:
            A list of trajectories, one for each task.
        """

        max_concurrent = self.n_parallel_agents

        # Initialize results list to store trajectories for all tasks
        all_trajectories = {}

        # Create a queue of tasks to process
        task_queue = list(enumerate(tasks))
        semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrent)
        index_queue: asyncio.Queue[int] = asyncio.Queue(maxsize=max_concurrent)
        for i in range(max_concurrent):
            index_queue.put_nowait(i)

        # Track completed trajectories
        completed = 0
        total = len(tasks)

        async def sem_wrapper(task_id, task):
            nonlocal completed
            async with semaphore:
                # Get an available index
                index = await index_queue.get()
                try:
                    self.envs[index] = self.env_class.from_dict({**task, **self.env_args})
                    self.agents[index] = self.agent_class(**self.agent_args)
                    assert self.agents[index] is not None and isinstance(self.agents[index], BaseAgent), "Agent is not initalized or not inheriting from BaseAgent"
                    self.agents[index].trajectory.task = task  # type: ignore
                    res = await self.run_agent_trajectory_async(index, application_id=task_id)
                    res.task = task
                    completed += 1
                    colorful_print(f"Progress: {completed}/{total} trajectories completed", "cyan")
                    return task_id, res
                finally:
                    # Put the index back in the queue when done
                    await index_queue.put(index)

        # Run all tasks concurrently
        results = await asyncio.gather(*[sem_wrapper(task_id, task) for task_id, task in task_queue])

        all_trajectories = {task_id: trajectory for task_id, trajectory in results}
        ordered_trajectories = [all_trajectories[i] for i in range(len(all_trajectories))]

        self.executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_concurrency)

        if self.engine_name == "verl":
            self.rollout_engine.wake_up()
            max_concurrent: Maximum number of concurrent tasks to process (defaults to self.n_parallel_agents)

        Returns:
            A list of trajectories, one for each task.
        """

        max_concurrent = self.n_parallel_agents

        # Initialize results list to store trajectories for all tasks
        all_trajectories = {}

        # Create a queue of tasks to process
        task_queue = list(enumerate(tasks))
        semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrent)
        index_queue: asyncio.Queue[int] = asyncio.Queue(maxsize=max_concurrent)
        for i in range(max_concurrent):
            index_queue.put_nowait(i)

        # Track completed trajectories
        completed = 0
        total = len(tasks)

        async def sem_wrapper(task_id, task):
            nonlocal completed
            async with semaphore:
                # Get an available index
                index = await index_queue.get()
                try:
                    self.envs[index] = self.env_class.from_dict({**task, **self.env_args})
                    self.agents[index] = self.agent_class(**self.agent_args)
                    assert self.agents[index] is not None and isinstance(self.agents[index], BaseAgent), "Agent is not initalized or not inheriting from BaseAgent"
                    self.agents[index].trajectory.task = task  # type: ignore
                    res = await self.run_agent_trajectory_async(index, application_id=task_id)
                    res.task = task
                    completed += 1
                    colorful_print(f"Progress: {completed}/{total} trajectories completed", "cyan")
                    return task_id, res
                finally:
                    # Put the index back in the queue when done
                    await index_queue.put(index)

        # Run all tasks concurrently
        results = await asyncio.gather(*[sem_wrapper(task_id, task) for task_id, task in task_queue])

        all_trajectories = {task_id: trajectory for task_id, trajectory in results}
        ordered_trajectories = [all_trajectories[i] for i in range(len(all_trajectories))]

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Smoke test of SWE-Master RL pipeline on a single L40S (1 GPU, 46 GB).
# Adapted from smoke_test_4b_single_h200.sh; the H200 had 143 GB so the
# vLLM gpu_memory_utilization and sequence lengths are cut here to fit 46 GB.
#
# Differences vs. the original 2x8-GPU script:
#   * 1 node, 1 GPU (was 2 nodes x 8 GPUs)
#   * No ulysses sequence-parallel, no tensor parallel
#   * Tiny batch sizes (train=1, mini=1, micro=1)
#   * Local demo parquet from data_examples/ used for train+val
#   * SWE-Master-4B-SFT model from local /home/temp/models cache
#   * gpu_memory_utilization 0.55 -> 0.38, response 4096 -> 3072 (46 GB budget)
#   * WANDB disabled (offline); only console + tensorboard
#   * Very short response length to fit in single-GPU memory
#   * One training epoch; save_freq pushed high so we don't write a checkpoint
set -x

# ----------------------- environment ------------------------------------
export VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND=FLASH_ATTN
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF="expandable_segments:False"
export VLLM_USE_V1=1
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export VLLM_ENGINE_ITERATION_TIMEOUT_S=100000000000
export HYDRA_FULL_ERROR=1
export WANDB_MODE=disabled
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=true
export NCCL_DEBUG=WARN
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
# Use parent venv directly: /workspace/venv already has every package the
# upstream runtime_env pip list pins. Cloning the venv into /tmp/ray and then
# pip-installing local wheels by relative path takes ~5min, then fails
# because Ray resolves './swebench_fork_*.whl' from a different cwd.
# See the docstring on run_ppo_agent in rllm.trainer.verl.train_agent_ppo.
export RLLM_USE_PARENT_VENV=1
# train_agent_ppo's runtime_env rebuilds PYTHONPATH from this; default is the

# FSDP param/optimizer offload pushes the 4B model to CPU RAM. Ray's default

content.text:
**Yes — OOM again.** Here's the definitive picture:

**What happened:** Kernel OOM-killer (SIGKILL — note there's *no* Python traceback in the log; it just froze mid-2nd-trajectory at `env.step step: 0 done`, and every trainer process vanished with RAM dropping from 31 GB → 2 GB). It got further this time though: **a full trajectory completed with a real reward** (`Trajectory 0 completed due to: TRUNCATION. Reward is 0.0`) before dying during the 2nd rollout.

**Why swap didn't save it:**
1. `swapon --show` is now **empty** — the 95 GB swap was active at launch but got deactivated during the run (unreliable here; the harness/sandbox resets it).
2. More fundamentally: vLLM and FSDP CPU-offload use **pinned (non-swappable) host memory**. Swap physically *cannot* rescue pinned pages.

**Root cause (not fixable by more swap):** Full-parameter PPO of a 4B model with FSDP CPU-offload needs ~40 GB host RAM just for the offloaded params + fp32 Adam optimizer states. This VM has **31 GB**. The original pipeline assumes a 64-GPU cluster with TBs of RAM.

**The fix that actually works:** Switch the actor to **LoRA** (`lora_rank`). Then only a low-rank adapter is trained — optimizer state shrinks from ~32 GB to a few MB, no CPU offload needed, no OOM. The rollout→reward machinery is already proven working; LoRA just lets the GRPO update actually execute so we can measure learning. This keeps the original pipeline/data — only the trainable parameter set shrinks, which is the standard (and here, only) way to fit 4B RL on this hardware.

toolUseResult.originalFile:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Smoke test of SWE-Master RL pipeline on a single L40S (1 GPU, 46 GB).
# Adapted from smoke_test_4b_single_h200.sh; the H200 had 143 GB so the
# vLLM gpu_memory_utilization and sequence lengths are cut here to fit 46 GB.
#
# Differences vs. the original 2x8-GPU script:
#   * 1 node, 1 GPU (was 2 nodes x 8 GPUs)
#   * No ulysses sequence-parallel, no tensor parallel
#   * Tiny batch sizes (train=1, mini=1, micro=1)
#   * Local demo parquet from data_examples/ used for train+val
#   * SWE-Master-4B-SFT model from local /home/temp/models cache
#   * gpu_memory_utilization 0.55 -> 0.38, response 4096 -> 3072 (46 GB budget)
#   * WANDB disabled (offline); only console + tensorboard
#   * Very short response length to fit in single-GPU memory
#   * One training epoch; save_freq pushed high so we don't write a checkpoint
set -x

# ----------------------- environment ------------------------------------
export VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND=FLASH_ATTN
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF="expandable_segments:False"
export VLLM_USE_V1=1
export VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1
export VLLM_ENGINE_ITERATION_TIMEOUT_S=100000000000
export HYDRA_FULL_ERROR=1
export WANDB_MODE=disabled
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=true
export NCCL_DEBUG=WARN
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
# Use parent venv directly: /workspace/venv already has every package the
# upstream runtime_env pip list pins. Cloning the venv into /tmp/ray and then
# pip-installing local wheels by relative path takes ~5min, then fails
# because Ray resolves './swebench_fork_*.whl' from a different cwd.
# See the docstring on run_ppo_agent in rllm.trainer.verl.train_agent_ppo.
export RLLM_USE_PARENT_VENV=1
# train_agent_ppo's runtime_env rebuilds PYTHONPATH from this; default is the
# old /workspace path, so it MUST be set to this VM's repo.
export RLLM_PROJECT_ROOT=/home/temp/swemaster_runpod
# Run rollout trajectories one container at a time. 31GB host RAM cannot hold
# 2 concurrent astropy containers + vLLM + FSDP (kernel OOM-killed the run).
# n=2 trajectories still run for the GRPO group, just sequentially. Honored by
# the cap added in rllm/engine/agent_execution_engine.py.
export RLLM_MAX_ROLLOUT_CONCURRENCY=1

# rllm package is not installed; expose it via PYTHONPATH
export PYTHONPATH=./DeepSWE_RL/rllm:./R2E-Gym/src:${PYTHONPATH:-}

# ---- host-RAM containment (this VM has only 31 GB; H200 pod had ~2 TB) ----
# FSDP param/optimizer offload pushes the 4B model to CPU RAM. Ray's default
# auto-sized object store (~30% RAM ≈ 9 GB) plus its 0.95 OOM-killer leaves no
# headroom and kills the worker mid-init. Pre-start a Ray cluster with a tiny
# object store and the memory monitor disabled, then attach to it. The docker
# rollout boundary is reached in fit_agent BEFORE the optimizer step, so we
# only need to survive the init peak, not hold fp32 optimizer states.
export RAY_memory_monitor_refresh_ms=0
export RAY_DISABLE_DOCKER_CPU_WARNING=1
export RAY_ADDRESS="local"
/home/temp/venv/bin/ray stop --force >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
/home/temp/venv/bin/ray start --head --num-cpus=8 \
    --object-store-memory=1500000000 \
    --memory=24000000000 \
    --disable-usage-stats >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
export RAY_ADDRESS="auto"

# ----------------------- paths ------------------------------------------
REPO_DIR=${REPO_DIR:-/home/temp/swemaster_runpod}
MODEL_PATH=${MODEL_PATH:-/home/temp/models/SWE-Master-4B-SFT}
TRAIN_PARQUET=${TRAIN_PARQUET:-${REPO_DIR}/data_examples/rl_data/public_swebench_verified/train_00000_verl.parquet}
VAL_PARQUET=${VAL_PARQUET:-${REPO_DIR}/data_examples/rl_data/public_swebench_verified/test_00000_verl.parquet}
PYTHON_BIN=${PYTHON_BIN:-/home/temp/venv/bin/python3}

PROJECT_NAME="swe_master_public_swebench"
TS=$(date +"%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S")
EXPERIMENT_NAME="smoke_${TS}"

DEFAULT_LOCAL_DIR="/home/temp/training_outputs/${PROJECT_NAME}/${EXPERIMENT_NAME}"
ROLLOUT_DATA_DIR="/home/temp/training_outputs_rollout/${PROJECT_NAME}/${EXPERIMENT_NAME}"
mkdir -p "${DEFAULT_LOCAL_DIR}" "${ROLLOUT_DATA_DIR}"

echo "Project: ${PROJECT_NAME}"
echo "Experiment: ${EXPERIMENT_NAME}"
echo "Model: ${MODEL_PATH}"
echo "Train data: ${TRAIN_PARQUET}"
echo "Val data: ${VAL_PARQUET}"

# ----------------------- launch -----------------------------------------
cd "${REPO_DIR}"
exec "${PYTHON_BIN}" -m rllm.trainer.verl.train_agent_ppo \
    algorithm.adv_estimator=loop \
    data.train_files="${TRAIN_PARQUET}" \
    data.val_files="${VAL_PARQUET}" \
    data.train_batch_size=1 \
    data.val_batch_size=1 \
    data.max_prompt_length=8192 \
    data.max_response_length=2048 \
    data.filter_overlong_prompts=True \
    data.filter_overlong_prompts_workers=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.model.path="${MODEL_PATH}" \
    actor_rollout_ref.hybrid_engine=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.lr=1e-6 \
    actor_rollout_ref.model.use_remove_padding=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.loss_agg_mode=seq-mean-token-sum \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_mini_batch_size=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_dynamic_bsz=False \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_max_token_len_per_gpu=7200 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_kl_loss=False \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.clip_ratio_high=0.28 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_coef=0.0 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_type=low_var_kl \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ulysses_sequence_parallel_size=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.model.enable_gradient_checkpointing=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.param_offload=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.optimizer_offload=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.tensor_model_parallel_size=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.name=vllm \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.mode="async" \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.chat_scheduler=verl.schedulers.completions_scheduler.CompletionsScheduler \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.enforce_eager=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.temperature=1.0 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization=0.38 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.n=2 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.val_kwargs.n=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.val_kwargs.temperature=0 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_use_dynamic_bsz=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.ref.fsdp_config.param_offload=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.entropy_coeff=0.0 \
    algorithm.kl_ctrl.kl_coef=0.0 \
    algorithm.mask_truncated_samples=False \
    algorithm.clip_advantages=False \
    trainer.critic_warmup=0 \
    trainer.logger=['console','tensorboard'] \
    trainer.project_name="${PROJECT_NAME}" \
    trainer.experiment_name="${EXPERIMENT_NAME}" \
    trainer.default_local_dir="${DEFAULT_LOCAL_DIR}" \
    trainer.rollout_data_dir="${ROLLOUT_DATA_DIR}" \
    trainer.val_before_train=False \
    trainer.n_gpus_per_node=1 \
    trainer.nnodes=1 \
    trainer.save_freq=1000 \
    trainer.test_freq=-1 \
    trainer.default_hdfs_dir=null \
    env.name=swe_arsenal \
    +env.env_args.delete_image=False \
    +env.env_args.scaffold="openhands" \
    +env.env_args.backend="docker" \
    agent.name=sweagent \
    agent.max_steps=20 \
    agent.overlong_filter=True \
    agent.trajectory_timeout=1800 \
    agent.async_engine=True \
    +agent.agent_args.scaffold="openhands" \
    trainer.total_epochs=15

content.text:
To directly answer your question: **yes, it OOM'd again** — kernel OOM-killer during the 2nd rollout (no traceback, all processes vanished, RAM 31→2 GB). It got further than before — one full trajectory completed with a real reward first.

**Root cause is structural, not tunable:** full-parameter PPO of a 4B model needs ~40 GB host RAM for CPU-offloaded params + fp32 Adam states; this VM has 31 GB, and the heaviest pages (vLLM/FSDP) are *pinned* so swap can't rescue them.

**Fix applied and now running:** switched the actor to **LoRA (rank 32)** and turned off FSDP CPU-offload. The trainable set drops from 4 B params to a small adapter, so the optimizer is megabytes instead of ~32 GB — it fits in RAM with no offload and no OOM. Everything else stays the original pipeline (loop/GRPO, swe_arsenal, openhands, sweagent, real astropy SWE-bench container, n=2). The rollout→reward path is already proven; LoRA lets the GRPO update actually execute so I can measure the learning signal. The watcher will report LoRA init → rollout → PPO step, or any LoRA/vLLM incompatibility. Continuing when it does.

Goal: run the SWE-Master **RL** pipeline (DeepSWE_RL/rllm verl trainer) end-to-end as a downscaled single-GPU smoke test, getting the agent rollout (per-task Docker SWE env via r2egym) to actually execute — the step that was blocked on the H200.

State of prior work (see [SETUP_NOTES.md](../../../../swemaster_runpod/SETUP_NOTES.md)): on the H200 the trainer reached `fit_agent` → `run_agent_trajectory_async` and died at `docker.errors.TLSParameterError` then `unshare: operation not permitted`. Two rollout-boundary issues noted there: (1) `r2egym/agenthub/runtime/docker.py` hardcodes `DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY=1` / a bogus `DOCKER_CERT_PATH` → must make env-driven/unset; (2) container start needs working `unshare` (works on THIS VM).

Resume plan on this L40S VM:
1. Docker access for user `temp` (group/socket), verify nested `unshare` inside a container.
2. Rebuild env on `/home/temp` per SETUP_NOTES recipe (uv venv py3.11, torch cu128, **agentica fork of verl** not volcengine, rllm/r2egym editable, vllm 0.10.2, flash-attn 2.8.3, setuptools<81, transformers<5, tensorboard).
3. Download `RUC-AIBOX/SWE-Master-4B-SFT`.
4. L40S-tuned smoke script (46 GB: lower gpu_memory_utilization ~0.35, short seqs, local model + in-repo demo parquet `data_examples/rl_data/ood_data/.../train_00000_verl.parquet`).
5. Launch; fix the `r2egym` docker TLS hardcode at the rollout boundary; push past it.

Goal: run the SWE-Master **RL** pipeline (DeepSWE_RL/rllm verl trainer) end-to-end as a downscaled single-GPU smoke test, getting the agent rollout (per-task Docker SWE env via r2egym) to actually execute — the step that was blocked on the H200.

State of prior work (see [SETUP_NOTES.md](../../../../swemaster_runpod/SETUP_NOTES.md)): on the H200 the trainer reached `fit_agent` → `run_agent_trajectory_async` and died at `docker.errors.TLSParameterError` then `unshare: operation not permitted`. Two rollout-boundary issues noted there: (1) `r2egym/agenthub/runtime/docker.py` hardcodes `DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY=1` / a bogus `DOCKER_CERT_PATH` → must make env-driven/unset; (2) container start needs working `unshare` (works on THIS VM).

Resume plan on this L40S VM:
1. Docker access for user `temp` (group/socket), verify nested `unshare` inside a container.
2. Rebuild env on `/home/temp` per SETUP_NOTES recipe (uv venv py3.11, torch cu128, **agentica fork of verl** not volcengine, rllm/r2egym editable, vllm 0.10.2, flash-attn 2.8.3, setuptools<81, transformers<5, tensorboard).
3. Download `RUC-AIBOX/SWE-Master-4B-SFT`.
4. L40S-tuned smoke script (46 GB: lower gpu_memory_utilization ~0.35, short seqs, local model + in-repo demo parquet `data_examples/rl_data/ood_data/.../train_00000_verl.parquet`).
5. Launch; fix the `r2egym` docker TLS hardcode at the rollout boundary; push past it.

Progress on this VM (2026-05-17): docker works for user `temp` (added to docker group + `chmod 666 /var/run/docker.sock`; nested containers start, unlike H200). Env rebuilt at `/home/temp/venv` (torch 2.8.0+cu128, vllm 0.10.2, flash-attn 2.8.3, transformers 4.57.6, agentica verl fork). Model at `/home/temp/models/SWE-Master-4B-SFT`. L40S script: `DeepSWE_RL/rllm/examples/swe/smoke_test_4b_single_l40s.sh` (gpu_mem_util 0.38, resp 3072, pre-starts Ray with tiny object store + RAY_memory_monitor_refresh_ms=0, RLLM_PROJECT_ROOT set). rllm needs lightweight deps installed manually (it's `-e --no-deps`): polars dm-tree datasets accelerate peft etc. r2egym docker TLS hardcode patched (env-driven, local socket when no remote ip).

KEY new constraint: 31 GB host RAM (H200 had ~2 TB). FSDP param/optimizer CPU offload of the 4B model OOMs the host at init (Ray killed WorkerDict at ~22 GB). Fix applied: **96 GB swapfile** at `/swapfile` (`sudo swapon`) so offload spills to the 1.2 TB disk — slow but lets the smoke run survive init/optimizer RAM peaks. Note: `actor_rollout_ref.rollout.swap_space` is NOT a valid verl config key (struct mode rejects it).

RESOLVED blockers (2026-05-17, all on branch setup/runpod-h200):
- Docker rollout (the H200 killer) WORKS here: containers start; `temp` added to docker group + `chmod 666 /var/run/docker.sock`.
- Demo RL parquet images are private (`harbor.weizhipin.com`) → UNPULLABLE. Public SWE-bench Verified images on Docker Hub work: `swebench/sweb.eval.x86_64.<id with __→_1776_>:latest`. Built `build_public_swe_parquet.py` → `data_examples/rl_data/public_swebench_verified/{train,test}_00000_verl.parquet` (instance astropy__astropy-12907, original swe_dataset.py schema).
- r2egym `docker.py`: TLS hardcode made env-driven + local-socket; **scoping bug** fixed (renamed local `make_test_spec`→`embedded_test_spec` at lines 203/227/249 so module import at L239 resolves).
- Host-RAM OOM (31 GB): full-param PPO of 4B needs ~40 GB CPU-offload RAM; pinned mem so swap can't help. FIX = **LoRA** (`actor_rollout_ref.model.lora_rank=32`, offload OFF) → optimizer is MB, RAM ~14 GB, no OOM. Also capped rollout concurrency to 1 via `RLLM_MAX_ROLLOUT_CONCURRENCY` env (patched rllm/engine/agent_execution_engine.py) — 31 GB can't run 2 concurrent SWE containers.
- `ppo_max_token_len_per_gpu` must be ≥ max_prompt+max_response (8192+2048=10240); set 12288.
